motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council request the City Attorney, in coordination with the Los Angeles Fire Department (LAFD) , Department of City Planning (DCP), and Department of Building and Safety (LAD BS), to obtain and provide to Council District I 5 the feasibility study for the JCT Jones Chemicals, Inc. (JCI) Harbor Gateway facility, and provide an assessment of whether and to what extent the study may be publicly disclosed. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council request the City Attorney, in coordination with the LAFD, DCP, and LADBS, to obtain and provide to Council District 15 any proposed consent order concerning the JCI Harbor Gateway facility, prior to adoption, and provide an assessment of whether and to what extent the consent order may be publicly disclosed. ~ PRESENTED BY: rv- TIMMcOSKER C CJ SECONDEDB~~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ -~ c=•==~
